model.encore_analytics.amazon_sp__return.raw_code:
-- Returns analysis by SKU and month
-- Return rate, return revenue impact, restocking fees

with base as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', date)   as month,
        marketplace,
        seller_sku,
        brand,
        listing_name,
        sum(units_sold)             as units_sold,
        sum(units_returned)         as units_returned,
        sum(product_sales)          as product_sales,
        sum(refunds)                as refund_amount,
        sum(cogs)                   as cogs_on_sold
    from {{ ref('amazon_sp__daily_revenue') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),

refund_detail as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as month,
        marketplace,
        seller_sku,
        sum(restocking_fee)              as restocking_fee
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__refund_events') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    b.month,
    b.marketplace,
    b.seller_sku,
    b.brand,
    b.listing_name,
    b.units_sold,
    b.units_returned,
    round(case when b.units_sold > 0
               then b.units_returned::float / b.units_sold * 100 end, 2) as return_rate_pct,
    round(b.product_sales, 2)                       as product_sales,
    round(b.refund_amount, 2)                       as refund_amount,
    round(coalesce(rd.restocking_fee, 0), 2)        as restocking_fee,
    round(b.refund_amount + coalesce(rd.restocking_fee, 0), 2) as net_refund_impact
from base b
left join refund_detail rd on rd.month = b.month
                          and rd.marketplace = b.marketplace
                          and rd.seller_sku = b.seller_sku
where b.units_returned > 0
order by b.month desc, return_rate_pct desc

model.encore_analytics.amazon_sp__monthl.raw_code:
-- Monthly P&L waterfall by brand — backs the Monthly Overview Hex tab
-- Aggregates daily_revenue to month x brand x marketplace

select
    date_trunc('month', date)                           as month,
    marketplace,
    brand,

    -- Volume
    sum(units_sold)                                     as units_sold,
    sum(units_returned)                                 as units_returned,

    -- Revenue
    round(sum(product_sales), 2)                        as product_sales,
    round(sum(shipping_credit), 2)                      as shipping_credit,
    round(sum(promo_discount), 2)                       as promo_discount,
    round(sum(refunds), 2)                              as refunds,
    round(sum(net_revenue), 2)                          as net_revenue,

    -- Fees
    round(sum(referral_fee), 2)                         as referral_fee,
    round(sum(fba_fee), 2)                              as fba_fee,
    round(sum(other_fees), 2)                           as other_fees,

    -- COGS & margin
    round(sum(cogs), 2)                                 as cogs,
    round(sum(cm_pre_cogs), 2)                          as cm_pre_cogs,
    round(sum(cm_after_cogs), 2)                        as cm_after_cogs,

    -- CM % (post-COGS)
    round(case when sum(product_sales) <> 0
               then sum(cm_after_cogs) / sum(product_sales) * 100 end, 2) as cm_pct,

    -- Storage / deal fees: null pending service_fee_events
    null::float                                         as fba_storage_fee,
    null::float                                         as deal_fee,
    null::float                                         as coupon_fee,

    -- ASP
    round(case when sum(units_sold) > 0
               then sum(product_sales) / sum(units_sold) end, 2) as avg_selling_price

from {{ ref('amazon_sp__daily_revenue') }}
group by 1, 2, 3
order by 1 desc, 2, 3

        sum(cogs)                                as cogs,
        sum(total_ad_spend)                      as ad_spend,
        sum(attributed_ad_sales)                 as attributed_ad_sales
    from {{ ref('int_amazon_combined__daily') }}
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    month,
    marketplace,
    units_sold,
    units_returned,
    round(case when units_sold > 0
               then units_returned / units_sold * 100 end, 2)              as return_rate_pct,
    round(gross_revenue, 2)                                                 as gross_revenue,
    round(net_revenue, 2)                                                   as net_revenue,
    round(ad_spend, 2)                                                      as ad_spend,
    round(attributed_ad_sales, 2)                                           as attributed_ad_sales,
    round(case when ad_spend > 0
               then attributed_ad_sales / ad_spend end, 4)                 as roas,
    round(case when gross_revenue > 0
               then ad_spend / gross_revenue * 100 end, 2)                 as tacos_pct,
    round(cm_after_cogs, 2)                                                 as cm_after_cogs,
    round(case when net_revenue > 0
               then cm_after_cogs / net_revenue * 100 end, 2)              as cm_margin_pct
from monthly
order by month desc, gross_revenue desc

model.encore_analytics.amazon_sp__daily_.raw_code:
-- Daily revenue waterfall per SKU — core SP mart for BM Report
-- Joins financial events + refunds + SKU master for COGS and brand
-- US only (Phase 1); CA to be unioned once SP pipeline completes for CA

with sales as (
    select
        posted_date                                     as date,
        marketplace,
        seller_sku,
        sum(product_sales)                              as product_sales,
        sum(shipping_credit)                            as shipping_credit,
        sum(gift_wrap)                                  as gift_wrap,
        sum(promo_discount)                             as promo_discount,
        sum(net_sales)                                  as net_sales,
        sum(referral_fee)                               as referral_fee,
        sum(fba_fee)                                    as fba_fee,
        sum(shipping_chargeback)                        as shipping_chargeback,
        sum(other_fees)                                 as other_fees,
        sum(contribution_margin_pre_cogs)               as cm_pre_cogs,
        sum(quantity_shipped)                           as units_sold
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__financial_events') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

refunds as (
    select
        posted_date                                     as date,
        marketplace,
        seller_sku,
        sum(refund_principal)                           as refund_principal,
        sum(refund_shipping)                            as refund_shipping,
        sum(restocking_fee)                             as restocking_fee,
        sum(total_refund)                               as total_refund,
        sum(quantity_returned)                          as units_returned
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__refund_events') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

sku_master as (
    select sku, brand, listing, segmentation, asin_tier, cogs
    from {{ ref('stg_sku_master') }}
)

select
    s.date,
    s.marketplace,
    s.seller_sku,
    m.brand,
    m.listing                                           as listing_name,
    m.segmentation,
    m.asin_tier,

    -- Volume
    s.units_sold,
    coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)                       as units_returned,
    s.units_sold + coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)        as net_units,

    -- Revenue waterfall
    round(s.product_sales, 2)                           as product_sales,
    round(s.shipping_credit, 2)                         as shipping_credit,
    round(s.gift_wrap, 2)                               as gift_wrap,
    round(s.promo_discount, 2)                          as promo_discount,
    round(coalesce(r.total_refund, 0), 2)               as refunds,
    round(s.net_sales + coalesce(r.total_refund, 0), 2) as net_revenue,

    -- Fee deductions (stored as negatives)
    round(s.referral_fee, 2)                            as referral_fee,
    round(s.fba_fee, 2)                                 as fba_fee,
    round(s.shipping_chargeback, 2)                     as shipping_chargeback,
    round(s.other_fees, 2)                              as other_fees,

    -- Contribution margin before COGS (fees already negative)
    round(s.cm_pre_cogs + coalesce(r.total_refund, 0), 2) as cm_pre_cogs,

    -- COGS from SKU master
    round(coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * s.units_sold, 2)       as cogs,
    round(
        s.cm_pre_cogs + coalesce(r.total_refund, 0)
        - coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * s.units_sold,
        2
    )                                                   as cm_after_cogs,

    -- Storage/deal/coupon fees: pending service_fee_events pipeline load
    null::float                                         as fba_storage_fee,
    null::float                                         as lt_storage_fee,
    null::float                                         as inbound_placement_fee,
    null::float                                         as deal_fee,
    null::float                                         as coupon_fee,
    null::float                                         as awd_fees,

    -- ASP
    round(case when s.units_sold > 0
               then s.product_sales / s.units_sold end, 2) as avg_selling_price

from sales s
left join refunds r    on r.date = s.date and r.marketplace = s.marketplace
                      and r.seller_sku = s.seller_sku
left join sku_master m on m.sku = s.seller_sku
order by s.date desc, s.product_sales desc

model.encore_analytics.amazon_ads__exec_.raw_code:
-- Exec Overview Table 1: Daily Sales + Sessions + PPC (US, SP only, Phase 1)
-- Sessions/CVR pull from amazon_sp__sales_traffic once pipeline loads data
-- New Product Sales: pending sales_traffic with asinGranularity=CHILD

with ppc as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        sum(impressions)    as ppc_impressions,
        sum(clicks)         as ppc_clicks,
        sum(cost)           as ppc_spend,
        sum(purchases7d)    as ppc_purchases,
        sum(sales_7d)       as ppc_sales
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_ads__sp_campaign_report') }}
    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2
),

financials as (
    select
        posted_date         as date,
        'US'                as marketplace,
        sum(product_sales)  as gross_sales,
        sum(quantity_shipped) as units
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__financial_events') }}
    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2
),

traffic as (
    select
        date,
        sum(sessions)       as sessions,
        sum(units_ordered)  as traffic_units,
        round(case when sum(sessions) > 0
                   then sum(units_ordered)::float / sum(sessions) * 100
              end, 2)       as cvr
    from {{ ref('amazon_sp__sales_traffic') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    f.date,
    f.marketplace,
    round(f.gross_sales, 2)                                                 as sales,
    f.units,
    round(case when f.units > 0 then f.gross_sales / f.units end, 2)       as avg_price,

    -- Sessions / CVR from sales_traffic (null until pipeline loads)
    t.sessions,
    t.cvr,

    -- New Product Sales: pending sales_traffic CHILD ASIN granularity
    null::float                                                             as new_product_sales,
    null::float                                                             as new_product_sales_pct,

    -- PPC metrics
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0), 2)                                     as ppc_spend,
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_sales, 0), 2)                                     as ppc_sales,
    round(case when f.gross_sales > 0
               then coalesce(p.ppc_sales, 0) / f.gross_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                           as ppc_sales_pct,
    round(case when f.gross_sales > 0
               then coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0) / f.gross_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                           as tacos

from financials f
left join ppc p     on p.date = f.date and p.marketplace = f.marketplace
left join traffic t on t.date = f.date
order by f.date desc

model.encore_analytics.amazon_ads__exec_.raw_code:
-- Exec Overview Table 2: Profitability waterfall (US, Phase 1)
-- Built from financial_events (Finances API / ShipmentEventList) + SKU master COGS
--
-- GAPS — pending service_fee_events pipeline load:
--   storage_fee / lt_storage_fee / inbound_placement / deal_fee / coupon_fee / awd_fees
--   These will populate once service_fee_events table is created by the pipeline

with sales as (
    select
        posted_date                         as date,
        seller_sku,
        sum(product_sales)                  as product_sales,
        sum(shipping_credit)                as shipping_credit,
        sum(promo_discount)                 as promo_discount,
        sum(net_sales)                      as net_sales,
        sum(referral_fee)                   as referral_fee,
        sum(fba_fee)                        as fba_fee,
        sum(shipping_chargeback)            as shipping_chargeback,
        sum(quantity_shipped)               as units_sold
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__financial_events') }}
    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2
),

refunds as (
    select
        posted_date                         as date,
        seller_sku,
        sum(refund_principal)               as refund_amount,
        sum(quantity_returned)              as units_returned
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__refund_events') }}
    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2
),

ppc as (
    select
        date,
        advertised_sku                      as seller_sku,
        sum(cost)                           as ppc_spend,
        sum(sales_7d)                       as ppc_sales,
        sum(purchases7d)                    as ppc_orders
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_ads__sp_product_ad_report') }}
    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2
),

sku_master as (
    select
        sku,
        brand,
        listing,
        cogs
    from {{ ref('stg_sku_master') }}
)

select
    s.date,
    s.seller_sku,
    m.brand,
    s.units_sold,
    coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)                                   as units_returned,

    -- Revenue waterfall
    round(s.product_sales, 2)                                       as product_sales,
    round(s.shipping_credit, 2)                                     as shipping_credit,
    round(s.promo_discount, 2)                                      as promo_discount,
    round(coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0), 2)                          as refunds,
    round(s.net_sales + coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0), 2)            as net_sales,

    -- Fee deductions (all negative)
    round(s.referral_fee, 2)                                        as referral_fee,
    round(s.fba_fee, 2)                                             as fba_fee,
    round(s.shipping_chargeback, 2)                                 as shipping_chargeback,

    -- Pending pipeline: storage fees, deal/coupon fees, inbound placement, AWD
    null::float                                                     as deal_fee,
    null::float                                                     as coupon_fee,
    null::float                                                     as fba_storage_fee,
    null::float                                                     as lt_storage_fee,
    null::float                                                     as inbound_placement_fee,
    null::float                                                     as awd_fees,

    -- COGS from SKU master (per-unit cost × units shipped)
    round(coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * s.units_sold, 2)                   as cogs,

    -- PPC
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0), 2)                             as ppc_spend,
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_sales, 0), 2)                             as ppc_sales,

    -- Contribution margin: net_sales + fees (fees are stored as negatives)
    round(
        s.net_sales + coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0)
        + s.referral_fee + s.fba_fee + s.shipping_chargeback,
        2
    )                                                               as cm_pre_cogs,

    round(
        s.net_sales + coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0)
        + s.referral_fee + s.fba_fee + s.shipping_chargeback
        - coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * s.units_sold,
        2
    )                                                               as cm_after_cogs,

    -- TACOS (ads spend / gross sales)
    round(case when s.product_sales > 0
               then coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0) / s.product_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                   as tacos

from sales s
left join refunds r    on r.date = s.date and r.seller_sku = s.seller_sku
left join ppc p        on p.date = s.date and p.seller_sku = s.seller_sku
left join sku_master m on m.sku = s.seller_sku
order by s.date desc, s.product_sales desc

    where marketplace = 'US'
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

sku_master as (
    select
        sku,
        asin,
        brand,
        listing,
        cogs,
        segmentation,
        asin_tier
    from {{ ref('stg_sku_master') }}
)

select
    f.date,
    f.seller_sku,
    coalesce(p.asin, m.asin)                                        as asin,
    m.brand,
    m.listing                                                       as listing_name,
    m.segmentation,
    m.asin_tier,

    f.units,
    coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)                                   as units_returned,

    round(f.product_sales, 2)                                       as product_sales,
    round(coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0), 2)                          as refunds,
    round(f.net_sales + coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0), 2)            as net_sales,
    round(f.referral_fee, 2)                                        as referral_fee,
    round(f.fba_fee, 2)                                             as fba_fee,
    round(f.cm_pre_cogs, 2)                                         as cm_pre_cogs,

    -- COGS from SKU master (per-unit cost × units shipped)
    round(coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * f.units, 2)                        as cogs,
    round(f.cm_pre_cogs - coalesce(m.cogs, 0) * f.units, 2)        as cm_after_cogs,

    -- Sessions/CVR: pending sales_traffic pipeline load
    null::int                                                       as sessions,
    null::float                                                     as cvr,

    -- PPC
    coalesce(p.ppc_impressions, 0)                                  as ppc_impressions,
    coalesce(p.ppc_clicks, 0)                                       as ppc_clicks,
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0), 2)                              as ppc_spend,
    round(coalesce(p.ppc_sales, 0), 2)                              as ppc_sales,
    round(case when f.product_sales > 0
               then coalesce(p.ppc_sales, 0) / f.product_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                   as ppc_sales_pct,
    round(case when f.product_sales > 0
               then coalesce(p.ppc_spend, 0) / f.product_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                   as tacos,

    round(case when f.product_sales <> 0
               then f.cm_pre_cogs / f.product_sales * 100
          end, 2)                                                   as cm_pct_pre_cogs

from financials f
left join refunds r   on r.date = f.date and r.seller_sku = f.seller_sku
left join ppc_asin p  on p.date = f.date and p.seller_sku = f.seller_sku
left join sku_master m on m.sku = f.seller_sku
order by f.date desc, f.product_sales desc

model.encore_analytics.amazon_ads__daily.name: amazon_ads__daily_performance
model.encore_analytics.amazon_ads__daily.description: Daily spend, impressions, clicks, purchases, and sales by marketplace and ad type (SP/SB/SD). SP uses 7-day attribution window; SB/SD use single window. KPIs: CTR, CPC, CVR, ACOS, ROAS computed per row.
model.encore_analytics.amazon_ads__daily.raw_code:
-- Daily spend, clicks, impressions, sales by marketplace and ad type (SP / SB / SD)
-- SP uses 7-day attribution window; SB/SD use their respective single window

select
    date,
    marketplace,
    ad_type,
    sum(impressions)                                                         as impressions,
    sum(clicks)                                                              as clicks,
    round(sum(cost), 2)                                                      as cost,
    sum(purchases)                                                           as purchases,
    round(sum(sales), 2)                                                     as sales,
    round(case when sum(impressions) > 0
               then sum(clicks) / sum(impressions) * 100 end, 4)            as ctr,
    round(case when sum(clicks) > 0
               then sum(cost) / sum(clicks) end, 4)                         as cpc,
    round(case when sum(clicks) > 0
               then sum(purchases) / sum(clicks) * 100 end, 4)              as cvr,
    round(case when sum(sales) > 0
               then sum(cost) / sum(sales) * 100 end, 2)                    as acos,
    round(case when sum(cost) > 0
               then sum(sales) / sum(cost) end, 4)                          as roas
from {{ ref('int_amazon_ads__all_campaigns') }}
group by 1, 2, 3
order by date desc, marketplace, ad_type

model.encore_analytics.int_amazon_combin.name: int_amazon_combined__daily
model.encore_analytics.int_amazon_combin.raw_code:
-- Daily combined view: SP organic revenue + ad spend per marketplace
-- Foundation for ROAS, TACoS, and full P&L calculations

with sp_daily as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        sum(product_sales)                   as gross_revenue,
        sum(net_revenue)                     as net_revenue,
        sum(units_sold)                      as units_sold,
        sum(units_returned)                  as units_returned,
        sum(cm_pre_cogs)                     as cm_pre_cogs,
        sum(cm_after_cogs)                   as cm_after_cogs,
        sum(cogs)                            as cogs,
        sum(referral_fee)                    as referral_fee,
        sum(fba_fee)                         as fba_fee
    from {{ ref('amazon_sp__daily_revenue') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

ads_daily as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        sum(cost)                            as total_ad_spend,
        sum(purchases)                       as ad_purchases,
        sum(sales)                           as attributed_ad_sales,
        sum(impressions)                     as impressions,
        sum(clicks)                          as clicks
    from {{ ref('amazon_ads__daily_performance') }}
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    coalesce(s.date, a.date)                    as date,
    coalesce(s.marketplace, a.marketplace)      as marketplace,
    coalesce(s.gross_revenue, 0)                as gross_revenue,
    coalesce(s.net_revenue, 0)                  as net_revenue,
    coalesce(s.units_sold, 0)                   as units_sold,
    coalesce(s.units_returned, 0)               as units_returned,
    coalesce(s.cm_pre_cogs, 0)                  as cm_pre_cogs,
    coalesce(s.cm_after_cogs, 0)                as cm_after_cogs,
    coalesce(s.cogs, 0)                         as cogs,
    coalesce(s.referral_fee, 0)                 as referral_fee,
    coalesce(s.fba_fee, 0)                      as fba_fee,
    coalesce(a.total_ad_spend, 0)               as total_ad_spend,
    coalesce(a.ad_purchases, 0)                 as ad_purchases,
    coalesce(a.attributed_ad_sales, 0)          as attributed_ad_sales,
    coalesce(a.impressions, 0)                  as impressions,
    coalesce(a.clicks, 0)                       as clicks,
    round(case when coalesce(a.total_ad_spend, 0) > 0
               then a.attributed_ad_sales / a.total_ad_spend end, 4)        as roas,
    round(case when coalesce(a.attributed_ad_sales, 0) > 0
               then a.total_ad_spend / a.attributed_ad_sales * 100 end, 2)  as acos,
    round(case when coalesce(s.gross_revenue, 0) > 0
               then coalesce(a.total_ad_spend, 0) / s.gross_revenue * 100 end, 2) as tacos
from sp_daily s
full outer join ads_daily a
    on a.date = s.date and a.marketplace = s.marketplace
order by date desc, marketplace

model.encore_analytics.int_sku_master_en.name: int_sku_master_enriched
model.encore_analytics.int_sku_master_en.raw_code:
with sku_master as (
    select
        trim(sku) as sku,
        trim(asin) as asin,
        trim(brand) as brand,
        trim(listing) as listing_name,
        trim(size_code) as size_code,
        try_to_double(replace(trim(cogs::varchar), '$', '')) as cogs,
        trim(segmentation) as segmentation,
        trim(seasonality) as seasonality,
        trim(discontinue_flag) as discontinue_flag
    from {{ source('google_sheets', 'google_sheets__sku_master') }}
    where trim(sku) is not null
      and trim(sku) != ''
),

sheet_skus as (
    select sku from sku_master
),

order_skus as (
    select distinct
        trim(oi.seller_sku) as sku,
        trim(oi.asin) as asin,
        case
            when upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'BB-%' then 'BlissnBaby'
            when upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'MM-%' then 'MindMint'
            when upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'SK-%' then 'Skinnies'
            when upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'RA-%'
              or upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'RNR-%'
              or upper(trim(oi.seller_sku)) like 'RS%' then 'Rainier'
            else null
        end as brand
    from {{ source('amazon_sp_us', 'order_items') }} oi
    where trim(oi.seller_sku) is not null
      and trim(oi.seller_sku) != ''
),

inferred as (
    select
        os.sku,
        os.asin,
        os.brand,
        cast(null as varchar) as listing_name,
        cast(null as varchar) as size_code,
        cast(null as number) as cogs,
        cast(null as varchar) as segmentation,
        cast(null as varchar) as seasonality,
        cast(null as varchar) as discontinue_flag
    from order_skus os
    left join sheet_skus ss on os.sku = ss.sku
    where ss.sku is null
      and os.brand is not null
),

combined as (
    select * from sku_master
    union all
    select * from inferred
),

sales_dates as (
    select
        s.sku,
        s.asin,
        min(s._loaded_at::date) as first_seen_date
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_sp__sales_traffic_by_sku') }} s
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    sm.sku,
    sm.asin,
    sm.brand,
    sm.listing_name,
    sm.size_code,
    sm.cogs,
    sm.segmentation,
    sm.seasonality,
    sm.discontinue_flag,
    sd.first_seen_date,
    case
        when sm.segmentation = 'NEW' then true
        else false
    end as is_new_product
from combined sm
left join sales_dates sd
    on sm.sku = sd.sku

model.encore_analytics.int_amazon_ads__a.raw_code:
-- Normalized campaign-level raw data combining SP / SB / SD ad types
-- SP uses 7-day attribution; SB/SD use their single attribution window
-- Downstream marts (daily_performance, campaign_performance) build on this

with sp as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        'SP'                            as ad_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_name,
        campaign_status,
        campaign_budget_type,
        campaign_budget_amount,
        impressions,
        clicks,
        cost,
        purchases7d                     as purchases,
        sales_7d                        as sales
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_ads__sp_campaign_report') }}
),

sb as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        'SB'                            as ad_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_name,
        campaign_status,
        campaign_budget_type,
        null::float                     as campaign_budget_amount,
        impressions,
        clicks,
        cost,
        purchases,
        sales
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_ads__sb_campaign_report') }}
),

sd as (
    select
        date,
        marketplace,
        'SD'                            as ad_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_name,
        campaign_status,
        null::varchar                   as campaign_budget_type,
        null::float                     as campaign_budget_amount,
        impressions,
        clicks,
        cost,
        purchases,
        sales
    from {{ ref('stg_amazon_ads__sd_campaign_report') }}
)

select * from sp
union all
select * from sb
union all
select * from sd

seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_data_.name: seed_product_data_provider
seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_data_.description:
Seed file containing reference data for product-specific data source providers.
This seed provides metadata about product catalog sources including data quality scores.

**Values**: event (95), gopuff (90), spins (98), manual (70), unknown (0)

**Data Quality Scores**: 
- SPINS: 98 (highest quality, comprehensive product database)
- Event: 95 (internal system, reliable)
- Gopuff: 90 (external catalog, good quality)
- Manual: 70 (manually entered, lower confidence)
- Unknown: 0 (no quality assessment)

**Usage**: Used by ref_product_data_provider to enrich product source codes.
Source data from: stg_event_product_profile.data_source, stg_event_fridge_rack_scan_products.product_data_provider

**Maintenance**: Add new providers with appropriate quality scores

provider_code.description: Provider code - primary key (event, gopuff, spins, manual, unknown)

provider_description.description: Detailed description of the product data provider

is_active.name: is_active
is_active.description: Boolean flag indicating if provider is currently active

provider_sort_order.name: provider_sort_order
provider_sort_order.description: Sort order for display in reports and UI

data_quality_score.name: data_quality_score

seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_recog.name: seed_product_recognition_status
seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_recog.description:
Seed file containing reference data for product recognition status codes from scan events.
This seed provides metadata about recognition outcomes including success indicators.

**Values**: recognized, unrecognized, pending, manual

**Successful Recognition** (is_successful = true):
- recognized: Product was successfully recognized by the system
- manual: Product was manually identified

**Unsuccessful Recognition** (is_successful = false):
- unrecognized: Product was not recognized by the system
- pending: Product recognition is pending

**Usage**: Used by ref_product_recognition_status to enrich product_recognition_status codes from 
stg_event_fridge_rack_scan_products. Drives product_recognized_count metric in fact_fridge_scan.

**Maintenance**: Add new status codes as ML recognition capabilities evolve

status_code.description: Status code - primary key (recognized, unrecognized, pending, manual)

status_description.name: status_description
status_description.description: Detailed description of the recognition status

is_successful.description: Boolean flag indicating if status represents successful product recognition

status_sort_order.name: status_sort_order
status_sort_order.description: Sort order for display in reports and UI

seed.encore_analytics.seed_fridge_sight_.name: seed_fridge_sight_state
seed.encore_analytics.seed_fridge_sight_.description:
Seed file containing reference data for fridge sight operational states.
This seed provides metadata about fridge states including operational status indicators.

**Values**: active, inactive, learning, maintenance, offline, unknown

**Operational States** (is_operational = true):
- active: Fridge is actively monitoring
- learning: Fridge is in learning mode

**Non-Operational States** (is_operational = false):
- inactive: Not actively monitoring
- maintenance: Under maintenance
- offline: Completely offline
- unknown: State cannot be determined

**Usage**: Used by ref_fridge_sight_state to enrich sight_state codes from stg_event_fridge_profile.

**Maintenance**: Add new states as fridge capabilities expand

state_code.description: State code - primary key (active, inactive, learning, maintenance, offline, unknown)

state_description.name: state_description
state_description.description: Detailed description of the operational state

is_operational.name: is_operational
is_operational.description: Boolean flag indicating if state represents an operational fridge

state_sort_order.name: state_sort_order
state_sort_order.description: Sort order for display in reports and UI

seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_actio.name: seed_product_action
seed.encore_analytics.seed_product_actio.description:
Seed file containing reference data for product action types used in inventory change events.
This seed provides human-readable names and descriptions for action codes found in staging data.

**Values**: added, removed, updated

**Action Types**:
- added: Product was added to fridge inventory
- removed: Product was removed from fridge inventory
- updated: Product information was updated

**Usage**: Used by ref_product_action to enrich action codes from stg_event_fridge_product_change_events.
These actions drive the metrics in fact_fridge_product_change (product_added_count, product_removed_count, product_updated_count).

**Maintenance**: Add new action types as inventory operations expand (e.g., restocked, expired)
